description: NaV₅O₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.66 Å. There are three inequivalent V sites. In the first V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There are four shorter (2.03 Å) and two longer (2.10 Å) V-O bond lengths. In the second V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner, edge, and face-sharing VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-59°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 2.00-2.26 Å. In the third V site, V is bonded to six O atoms to form a mixture of corner, edge, and face-sharing VO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 42-59°. There are a spread of V-O bond distances ranging from 1.99-2.18 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four V atoms to form OV₄ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids, corners with four equivalent OV₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one OV₄ trigonal pyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three V atoms to form distorted ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with three equivalent ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent OV₄ trigonal pyramids, edges with three equivalent ONa₂V₃ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent OV₄ trigonal pyramids. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three equivalent V atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five V atoms.
